Package dev.px.core.math

Class Vec3

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.math.Vec3
public final class Vec3 extends Object
An immutable 3D double vector: world positions, motion, and directions.

Adapters convert to and from the game's own vector type at the boundary, so everything above the adapter speaks one type across every version.
